title: Avatars
description: avatars.json (data folder root): the user's avatar choices for every board, a map name -> look, where name is "claude", "you" or a teammate name in handle form. Types SavedAvatarMap and SavedLook in src/board/avatars.ts; written by Store.saveAvatars (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename). Both reading and writing go through cleanAvatars: names that don't match the pattern (or are over 64 chars) are skipped, at most 500 names are kept, only known part names and #rrggbb colours (lowercased) are kept, and a name with no valid field is dropped. So the Bun daemon drops unknown fields; every field of a look is optional and a missing one means the default. A port may drop unknown fields here too, as the Bun daemon does.

accessory.description: crown and bow only in files written before hats had their own slot; they read as that hat with accessory none, and the next save writes that shape.

name.description: Only on the "claude" entry: the name shown in place of "Claude"; one line, at most 24 characters, never "Claude" itself.
